pages.text: Wrung from $(l)Miasma Wraiths$(), $(l)Pustules$() and $(l)Censer Monks$(), and found in the Gravewarden's hoard. It binds the Consecrated Cleaver and the Plaguebane Amulet.
The Gravewarden's own blades, and some of the Pale Rider's. Forged into the $(l)Consecrated Cleaver$().
What remains of the Pale Rider. Bound in gold it becomes the $(l)Plaguebane Amulet$().
